about: The prose and fixed fields of release r5.2's MANIFEST.json, verbatim (results/capture_ruling_a19_2026-09-25_r5_2), which rfisher records capture-release writes beside the fields it computes.

fields.description: Revision 5.2 of the capture ruling: r5.1 with the ground-credit sensitivity reading in the settled form (DECISIONS.md item 41, B-1): (1 - gamma) at B-1's reconciled range gamma in place of (1 - gamma^2) at the all-class gamma, and channel 24's ceiling (1 - 0.95); a label change only (26 becomes idealized-only); no rule, gate, bar or disposition of the no-credit ruling changes

amendment19.ch24: item 34: ch24_2020_basis_a18.py --set CH24_BASIS=measured2020 runs the channel 24 lane's own code (a19_inputs.CH24_CODE) on its own products (12 cohort events, in-band bins 676 to 691 and the channel 37 bins; at most 8 frames per event); no borrowed quantity (the pilot-to-in-band correction is retired; never opened, tests/test_a18.py test_ch24_no_borrowed_quantity); its credit readings take the ground credit at its ceiling (1 - 0.95) (item 41; (1 - 0.95^2) through r5.1), because channel 24 has no measured coherence
amendment19.tau_lower_bounds: item 35: ruling_a18.py --set TAU_LOWER_BOUNDS=on; each unmeasured or refused class with a within-dump 95 % lower bound is priced at the least bound over every variant of the autocorrelation lane and its check, capped at the longest lag the lane observes (32 frames, 1.34 s; a longer bound is a model extrapolation), never below the admissible minimum; exclusion side only (the keep side reads G at the cap); tau_lower_bounds_a19.csv lists every bound and its use
amendment19.credit_readings: credit_readings/r3 (the r5 rule with the ground credit) and credit_readings/r2 (with the 200 ns filter plus S and the ground credit), built by build_release.py --credit-reading; postprocessing_sensitivity.csv reads them
amendment19.revision_4: both amendment 19 switches off with the default flags otherwise: revision 4's tables byte for byte (test_reproduces_r4)

world.name: none
world.exclusion_tolerance: lambda_none, the qualified exact-time reference at one on-sky year (the record's lambda_none column)
world.delay_filter_credit: none (the 11.4 dB S of revision 2 is removed)
world.ground_filter_credit: none in the ruling (item 17); the credit readings take (1 - gamma) at B-1's reconciled range gamma (item 41), channel 24 at (1 - 0.95)
world.bin_fill: item 4's fill on the no-filter per-bin tolerances of the exact-time reference; part of the BAO-band gain model, not a credit (item 17)
world.revision_3: the ground credit on; reproduced byte for byte by --ch24-basis borrowed --tau-lower-bounds off --ground on (tests/test_a18.py test_reproduces_r3)
world.revision_2: the 200 ns world with S and the ground credit; reproduced byte for byte by --ch24-basis borrowed --tau-lower-bounds off --world 200ns --ground on (test_reproduces_r2)

record.note: frozen; its columns are reproduced unchanged in table_of_record_a18.csv

columns.r3_names: under the no-filter world the exclusion-side ratio columns are named R_exclusion (a18_<range>_R_exclusion in table_of_record_a18.csv, <range>_R_exclusion in run/a18_full.csv, R_exclusion_* in the phase limit) in place of R_deployed; in run/*.json the per-policy keys R_dep, R_dep_G1, R_floor and S keep their names and hold the exclusion side's values in this world (tolerance lam_exclusion, S the bin fill alone); R_none is A_net G / lambda_none with no credit, as before. r4: the exclusion side takes no ground credit, so <range>_ground_credit_db is 0.0 on every range, <range>_rho keeps the measured coherence, and <range>_rescue_rho is the coherence a ground filter would need with no credit taken; run/*.json switches carry GROUND_CREDIT: off
columns.table_of_record_a18: every column of the frozen record unchanged, then a18_disposition and a18_reason (the amendment 18 ruling's disposition and reason on the rows it rules, the item 9 reason on channel 24's no-product rows, the record's own on pilot rows and channel 37), a18_deciding_range (excise: long if it excises, else short, as the record books; otherwise the BAO range nearest to excision), a18_deciding_bar_db and per range a18_<range>_bar_db (dB over tolerance, least policy or lowest epoch, blank at the floor), and per range the ruling's own columns under amendment 18 (A_net, gate and R in the per-frame covariance ratio A_net^2 N n_b; tau, least tau and G to four significant figures)

sensitivities.keep_gap_a18: floor channels: the detection gate against the stated keep rule (item 5), power dB and amplitude dB (half); independent of the world and of the ground credit, byte-identical to revisions 2 and 3
sensitivities.duration_nofilter: every bar at 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 and 10 on-sky years in the no-filter world, residual averaging down like noise; T* stays 1 on-sky year; lambda_none(t) / lambda_none(1) from the no-filter bank without the stability gate (flagged per duration), with the least bar on a 0.01-year grid from 1 to 10 years
sensitivities.postprocessing_sensitivity: per channel, the r5 ruling (no credit; columns r4_*) against its credit readings (credit_readings/r3, the ground credit (1 - gamma) at B-1's reconciled range gamma; credit_readings/r2, the 200 ns filter plus S with the ground credit; columns r3_* and r2_*): disposition and deciding bar in each, the item 18 label (robust to post-processing, idealized-only with the credit that removes it, or not excised), the r4 rule variants (G = 1, the cleaner polarization with its floor test, the archive shares) and the item 18 promotion
sensitivities.G1: a18_g1.json: unmeasured classes at G = 1 (item 3's G = 1 sensitivity: unmeasured and refused classes at G = 1, a class with a within-dump bound at its bound, triage row 22); the literal G = 1 reading (every class at G = 1) is the ruling's R1 and its own column
sensitivities.ch24_per_bin_a19: channel 24 per in-band bin (676 to 691) on its 2020 in-band measurement: per class the net excess in floor scatters and the measured test; per BAO range and the 0.3 m range the bar at the admissible minimum G of 4 frames, at G = 1, and with both credits (the 200 ns filter plus S and the ground credit at its ceiling, (1 - 0.95))
sensitivities.tau_lower_bounds_a19: every within-dump lower bound read (lane, check, least variant, the cap at the observed span), whether it prices a class, and the range's bar and G with the bounds off (r4) and on (r5), at the admissible minimum and at G = 1
sensitivities.a18_bounds_off: run/a18_bounds_off.json and run/a18_g1_bounds_off.json: the r5 producer with TAU_LOWER_BOUNDS=off (revision 4's a18.json and a18_g1.json byte for byte)
sensitivities.promotion_least_corners: B-2's least admissible and least overall corner per excised channel, on the r5.1 readings (b_list/B-2/r51)

r5_1.row_4: TAU_CENSOR=all: a tau or trim probe at the 15 s lag minimum is censored (tau <= 15 s) and priced as an unmeasured class, at its within-dump bound (B-4's lane run for 15 ew3, 0.6961 s) or the admissible minimum
r5_1.row_22: G1_NAMES=literal: literal G = 1 (every class at G = 1) in the verdict texts and its own columns (dispositions_a18.csv sensitivity_literal_G1_disposition and literal_G1_bar_db; postprocessing_sensitivity.csv r4_literal_G1_*); the G = 1 sensitivity run is renamed unmeasured classes at G = 1
r5_1.row_24: ch24_2020_basis_a18.py --per-bin-own-events: each bin's G from the events that contain it; edge bins labelled
r5_1.row_26: robustness_credit_a18.py --variant-labels: n/a (no archive shares) and at floor (cleaner polarization at the floor)
r5_1.row_35: SWITCH_RECORD=all (every run records every switch) and BOUND_SOURCE=fits (0.918 s and 0.439 s from fits_check.csv)
r5_1.B3: BOUND_CALIBRATION=on: a bound prices a class only if at most 5 % of B-3's 91 channel 37 null cells certify at or above it
r5_1.B2: promotion_least_corners.csv: B-2's declared grid rerun on the r5.1 readings (b_list/B-2/r51), least corner per excised channel
r5_1.revision_5: the default flags: build_release.py --rel <scratch> --run <scratch> --tables-only is revision 5's tables byte for byte (tests/test_a18.py test_reproduces_r5)

r5_2.credit_form: CREDIT_FORM=one_minus_gamma: B-1 settles the form from the ground filter's definition (a per-day filter leaves f = 1 - |E V|^2 / E|V|^2; for the pair statistic gamma the least f any amplitude fluctuation allows is 1 - gamma, the most generous credit the measured gamma allows); the rescue coherence is read in the same form
r5_2.credit_gamma: CREDIT_GAMMA=reconciled: B-1 section 3, the range's gamma is the median over its measured (gain) classes, the all-class median where none is measured, clamped to [0, 0.95] (steady_share_ranges.csv gamma_reconciled, reproduced on every range, test_r52_credit)
r5_2.ch24: the ground credit at its ceiling in the settled form, (1 - 0.95), in the credit readings and the per-bin both-credits column
r5_2.revision_5_1: --r51 (or --r52 --credit-form one_minus_gamma_sq --credit-gamma released) with --tables-only: r5.1's tables, promotion_least_corners.csv and PROMOTION_EVIDENCE.md byte for byte (tests/test_a18.py test_reproduces_r51)

fields.files_note: every release file but MANIFEST.json and tests_a18.txt, whose sha256 is under tests
